name: Edith V. Adams (Childs)
notable_stories: Likeness noted between her, Trudy Adams, and Serena Trumbo
George noted a strong resemblance between Trudy, Aunt Edith and their grandmother Serena.
milestones: Census 1920: Douglas County, Oregon, aged 7, born Oregon
sources: Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, compiled by William W. "Bill" Allen (2 April 2011 edition)
Newspaper clippings and obituaries in Bill Allen’s family document (2011)
Family research emails, 2011–2013 (John and Barbara Adams with Irma Kulp Zacher, George F. Adams, Bill Allen and others)
1920 U.S. census, Douglas County, Oregon, household 51, sheet 9 (FamilySearch index, accessed 2 Apr 2013)
notes: Pictured in a family photograph c. 1919 with her family [Bill Allen, Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, 2011, line 6079]
She had two sons, surname Childs; their names are not recorded.

UNPROVEN: her marriage to Thomas Childs and their two sons come from family recollection (Brendan Adams, 2026); no document in the collection records them. An earlier note cited "memoir p. 57", but neither John’s nor Barbara’s memoir mentions it.
